+  test('createPersisterRestoreResult marks the object as restored snapshot', () => {
+    const error = new Error('persisted error')
+    const state: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,

+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(null)).toBe(false)

+

+      data: 'cached data',

+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',

+    const persister = vi.fn(async () => {
+      return createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: 'cached data',
+        state: persistedState,
+      })
+    })
+
+    // Listen to query cache to verify no 'success' action is dispatched
+    const actions: Array<string> = []
+    const unsubscribe = queryCache.subscribe((event) => {
+      if (event.type === 'updated' && event.action) {
+        actions.push(event.action.type)
+      }
+    })
+
+    const query = queryCache.build(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn,
+      persister,

+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+
+export const persisterRestoreMarker = Symbol('persisterRestoreMarker')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  [persisterRestoreMarker]: true
+  __persisterRestore?: true
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    ...result,
+    [persisterRestoreMarker]: true,
+    __persisterRestore: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult<any, any> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    ((value as any)[persisterRestoreMarker] === true ||
+      (value as any).__persisterRestore === true)
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState(
+  liveState: QueryState,
+  persistedState: QueryState,
+): QueryState {
+  const liveHasData = liveState.data !== undefined
+  const persistedHasData = persistedState.data !== undefined
+
+  // Determine winning data side
+  let winningData: unknown = liveState.data
+  let winningDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt
+  let winningDataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+
+  if (
+    persistedHasData &&
+    (!liveHasData || persistedState.dataUpdatedAt > liveState.dataUpdatedAt)
+  ) {
+    winningData = persistedState.data
+    winningDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt
+    winningDataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else if (liveHasData) {
+    winningData = liveState.data
+    winningDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt
+    winningDataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else {
+    winningData = undefined
+    winningDataUpdatedAt = 0
+    winningDataUpdateCount = 0
+  }
+
+  // Determine winning error side
+  const liveHasError = liveState.error != null
+  const persistedHasError = persistedState.error != null
+
+  let winningError: unknown = null
+  let winningErrorUpdatedAt = 0
+  let winningErrorUpdateCount = 0
+  let winningFetchFailureCount = 0
+  let winningFetchFailureReason: unknown = null
+
+  if (persistedHasError && liveHasError) {
+    if (persistedState.errorUpdatedAt > liveState.errorUpdatedAt) {
+      winningError = persistedState.error
+      winningErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt
+      winningErrorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+      winningFetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+      winningFetchFailureReason = persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+    } else {
+      winningError = liveState.error
+      winningErrorUpdatedAt = liveState.errorUpdatedAt
+      winningErrorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+      winningFetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+      winningFetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+    }
